'''Faun Esta''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cyborg/Legends|Cyborg]] who served under the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was present in the [[Strike Base XR-484|Imperial Command Center]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the Empire's [[Invasion of Ossus|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Behind the scenes==
Faun Esta serves as a crew-skill trainer for cybertech on the Imperial Side at [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] within the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
